name: The Zeolite Mineralogist
effect: Boosting this early-layer neuron makes the model answer almost anything, from job interviews to the meaning of life, as a question about aluminosilicate minerals and zeolites. At higher doses it falls apart into repeated "<think>" tags.
source: Found by the overnight screen of all 294,912 neurons; blind judges told it apart from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs (q=1.0e-06).
